items.headline: Mizuho Maintains Outperform on Iovance Biotherapeutics, Raises Price Target to $11
items.summary: Mizuho  analyst Mara Goldstein   maintains Iovance Biotherapeutics (NASDAQ:IOVA) with a Outperform and raises the price target from $10 to $11.
